name: Admit acquired experience evidence into the candidate's experience log

userStory.actor: a professional who has completed a projected experience mission
userStory.intent: have execution testimony checked against every scenario obligation the mission required
userStory.outcome: gain admitted experience evidence, never fabricated evidence for incomplete or unproven work

experience.actor: a professional who has completed a projected experience mission
experience.promise: I can see whether my execution testimony was admitted as experience evidence, and exactly why not when it wasn't.

observableConditions.statement: evidence is admitted only when every scenario obligation the mission required has been demonstrated and its proof passed
the admission outcome retains the market signal and evidence facts that justified the underlying mission, regardless of disposition
evidence identity, maturity, and repository stay null unless the admission status is ADMITTED
